| | Hi Friend, **This election will be decided by the people who show up.** Right now, you can vote early, on your own schedule, without waiting until Election Day.Here’s how:
* **Vote early in person.** [Early voting is open now](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141766344/654666343/-311190476?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjMvMS8xMjQ3MDYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZDFhMTE5MzItMTljYy1mMTExLWJmNWItMDAyMjQ4MjlmODY5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=17Nury1Z_lgQXcop6ULjjS_Q0qtB8NCN9XQQRfkM-30=&emci=02cdf1fd-0ecc-f111-bf5b-00224829f869&emdi=d1a11932-19cc-f111-bf5b-00224829f869&ceid=1071883) through Monday, November 2nd. Your ballot goes straight into the ballot counter, just like on Election Day.
* **Voting by mail?** Your ballot must arrive by Election Day. A postmark isn’t enough. Mail it back right away, or drop it off at the election office that sent it by 5PM on November 3rd. If you vote by mail-in or absentee ballot, [track your ballot here](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141766345/654666344/2119055919?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjMvMS8xMjQ3MDYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZDFhMTE5MzItMTljYy1mMTExLWJmNWItMDAyMjQ4MjlmODY5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=17Nury1Z_lgQXcop6ULjjS_Q0qtB8NCN9XQQRfkM-30=&emci=02cdf1fd-0ecc-f111-bf5b-00224829f869&emdi=d1a11932-19cc-f111-bf5b-00224829f869&ceid=1071883).
* **Not registered yet?** You can still register when you vote. Just bring proof of where you live.
* **Prefer Election Day?** [Polls are open Tuesday, November 3rd](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141766347/654666356/1790631974?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjMvMS8xMjQ3MDYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZDFhMTE5MzItMTljYy1mMTExLWJmNWItMDAyMjQ4MjlmODY5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=17Nury1Z_lgQXcop6ULjjS_Q0qtB8NCN9XQQRfkM-30=&emci=02cdf1fd-0ecc-f111-bf5b-00224829f869&emdi=d1a11932-19cc-f111-bf5b-00224829f869&ceid=1071883), until 8PM. If you’re in line by 8PM, you can vote.

As the proud daughter of immigrants, I watched my hardworking parents struggle to make ends meet — and it made me wonder: **how could life be so difficult, even when we’ve done everything right?**
Today, too many Oregonians are facing the same struggles my parents did. They’re doing everything they can to pay the bills and put food on the table, but they’re _still coming up short._
That’s why I ran for Congress — to make life better for hardworking families all across OR-06, and guarantee a better future for the next generation.
I’m honored to have spent the past four years delivering results for this district, and I’m ready to keep delivering progress for families from Salem to McMinnville.
**[But National Republicans have come after this seat before, and with the House majority on the line this year, we need to be doing everything we can to defend this seat. It's Chris.
At our first debate on Tuesday, the moderator asked John Sununu a simple question: What is your specific proposal for saving Social Security? Here's what he said:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/98006c6a-1c80-494a-8639-38501dfa384c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[DONATE](https://substack.com/redirect/98006c6a-1c80-494a-8639-38501dfa384c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
He won't say what his plan is because he knows how deeply unpopular it is. But Granite Staters know the truth: **John Sununu was a leading architect of the scheme to privatize Social Security.** Then at an AARP forum with Granite Staters, he would only say his old plan doesn't fit today's needs.
My answer is simple. People pay into Social Security their whole working lives, and they deserve to know it'll be there when they retire. **I 'll oppose any cuts to benefits, and I won't tell anyone they have to work longer to get what they've already earned.**
That wasn't the only question Sununu dodged. When he was asked whether he would have voted to confirm Pete Hegseth, RFK Jr., and Kristi Noem, he said:
_**" I wouldn't have voted for all three of those, and I'm not going to litigate each one of them."**_
So he would have confirmed at least some of them, and he won't tell you which ones. **Hegseth was confirmed by a single tie-breaking vote.** In the Senate one vote can decide who runs the Pentagon. Now the so-called Secretary of War almost livestreamed an execution. That madness could have been stopped by one Senator. But Sununu won't tell us whether or not it would have been him.
This is the same John Sununu who cheered on Trump's war in Iran, calling it a success. That war has sent New Hampshire's energy prices to record highs. I've voted to end it, and I'll keep fighting to rein it in.
And behind closed doors, John Sununu was caught on camera saying the quiet part out loud. _**He said this race "is important to President Trump's agenda and to the successes that have been made in Washington."**_
That's who he'd be working for. **He has Donald Trump 's endorsement and tens of millions of dollars in outside Republican money behind him.** With 15 days until Election Day, they're betting New Hampshire voters won't notice what he refuses to say in public.
**We 're going to make sure they do. But I need your help to keep our message on the air.**
**[Will you chip in $15 right now to help us hold John Sununu accountable and win this seat?](https://substack.com/redirect/98006c6a-1c80-494a-8639-38501dfa384c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[ DONATE](https://substack.com/redirect/98006c6a-1c80-494a-8639-38501dfa384c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Thank you for being in this with me,
Chris
Before you go!
**John Sununu 's megadonors have funneled over $60 million to flood the New Hampshire airwaves and drown out our message.**
We can't let Republicans buy this seat -- our shot at a Democratic Senate majority depends on keeping the Granite State blue.
**[Will you chip in whatever you're able to today to ensure we have the resources to fight back, elect Chris, and flip the Senate in just 15 days?](https://substack.com/redirect/98006c6a-1c80-494a-8639-38501dfa384c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.

Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. We keep a close eye on them too. Depending on which polls you look at, the midterm elections could be shaping up as a major rebuke to Donald Trump and his anti-democracy allies. But we’ve all learned the hard way from past elections that polls aren’t the same as votes. We can’t take anything for granted in the next few weeks. And some of the most critical state-level elections — looking at you, Georgia and Ohio — could be decided by the thinnest of margins. So nothing matters more than maximizing turnout right now, and ensuring pro-democracy candidates have all the support they need to win. = | If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: = | = = | = = | = Individual donations make a particularly big difference in state-level elections, where campaigns typically have lower budgets. And some of the races we’re targeting for November will be decided by fewer than 1,000 votes. Hitting the “refresh” button or looking for new polls won’t change the outcome, but donating today could. _Friend,_ When we talk about building a Tennessee that works for everyone, _we mean _everyone_._ That means _investing in our historically Black colleges and universities_ , protecting our communities from environmental racism, closing the healthcare gap, and _ensuring that Black families across our state have true equity, economic security, and a seat at the table._ **If you haven't seen our latest video yet, take a couple of minutes to _watch our team's message live from the TSU game:_** **** 👉 **[Watch and share the video on Facebook here](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141766725/654668938/-124982026?refcode=10-19-TSU&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83ODg3MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyMzljYjFiMC0xOWNjLWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDIyNDgyOWY4NjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=4rAQ5JPn51dHpBmxbsp_IZmuKw6234Du0_CkFWorHIM=&emci=386141b5-11cc-f111-bf5b-00224829f869&emdi=239cb1b0-19cc-f111-bf5b-00224829f869&ceid=53531271)** For too long, politicians in Nashville have ignored the needs of Black Tennesseans— _from underfunding vital institutions and allowing polluting industries to target minority neighborhoods,_ to _blocking Medicaid expansion t_ hat would save lives in urban and rural communities alike. **Jerri's platform for Black Tennesseans and working families is built on real, material change:**
* **True Educational Equity:** Fully funding our public schools and supporting institutions like TSU, rather than pushing scam voucher schemes that drain resources from our kids.
* **Healthcare Justice:** Expanding Medicaid to close the racial health disparities gap, protecting maternal health equity (including supporting Black midwife fellows), and wiping out crushing medical debt.
* **Environmental Dignity :** Enforcing strict clean air and water standards to stop corporate polluters from dumping toxic data centers and industrial projects into Black and brown neighborhoods.
* **Economic Opportunity:** Fighting for a real living wage, supporting Black-owned small businesses, and dismantling systemic barriers to housing and wealth-building.

**We are building a multi-racial, cross-state coalition to shock the establishment this November** — _and we can't do it without**you.**_ _Watch the video now_ , share it with a friend, and if you're ready to elect a governor who will fight _for_ you, **_[chip in $10, $25, or whatever you can spare to help us take back Tennessee](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141766726/654668939/550850740?refcode=10-19-TSU&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83ODg3MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyMzljYjFiMC0xOWNjLWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDIyNDgyOWY4NjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=4rAQ5JPn51dHpBmxbsp_IZmuKw6234Du0_CkFWorHIM=)_** _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | [DONATE $10](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141766727/654668940/1755811102?amount=10&express_lane=true&refcode=10-19-TSU&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83ODg3MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyMzljYjFiMC0xOWNjLWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDIyNDgyOWY4NjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=4rAQ5JPn51dHpBmxbsp_IZmuKw6234Du0_CkFWorHIM=)

clean_body: | Friend, When we talk about building a Tennessee that works for everyone, we mean everyone. That means investing in our historically Black colleges and universities , protecting our communities from environmental racism, closing the healthcare gap, and ensuring that Black families across our state have true equity, economic security, and a seat at the table. If you haven't seen our latest video yet, take a couple of minutes to watch our team's message live from the TSU game: ** 👉 For too long, politicians in Nashville have ignored the needs of Black Tennesseans— from underfunding vital institutions and allowing polluting industries to target minority neighborhoods, to blocking Medicaid expansion t hat would save lives in urban and rural communities alike. Jerri's platform for Black Tennesseans and working families is built on real, material change: True Educational Equity: Fully funding our public schools and supporting institutions like TSU, rather than pushing scam voucher schemes that drain resources from our kids. Healthcare Justice: Expanding Medicaid to close the racial health disparities gap, protecting maternal health equity (including supporting Black midwife fellows), and wiping out crushing medical debt. Environmental Dignity : Enforcing strict clean air and water standards to stop corporate polluters from dumping toxic data centers and industrial projects into Black and brown neighborhoods. Economic Opportunity: Fighting for a real living wage, supporting Black-owned small businesses, and dismantling systemic barriers to housing and wealth-building. We are building a multi-racial, cross-state coalition to shock the establishment this November — and we can't do it withoutyou. Watch the video now , share it with a friend, and if you're ready to elect a governor who will fight for you, = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | = = | = = | = = Let's roll up our sleeves and win this together. Thank you, Jerri Green Democratic Nominee for Tennessee Governor P.S. Early voting is underway, right now through October 29th.Make a plan to vote, bring your family, and check out . ads, mobilize more volunteers, and host more campaign events in the final
stretch of this race. We can’t lose out on an opportunity like that.

I don’t expect you to pitch in $6,000,

name: Deb Haaland
subject: Trump is TRIPLING down:
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY DEB FOR NEW MEXICO**
body:
| | | [](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/1102?refcode=jtk1586-fr-nd&t=1&akid=13322%2E400544%2EM2OAIH)
---
Friend, Trump just TRIPLED down on his attacks against New Mexico.
[](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/17387?refcode=jtk1586-fr-nd&t=2&akid=13322%2E400544%2EM2OAIH)
**While this might seem like a ridiculous stunt, friend, it’s not.** Trump is trying to rebrand New Mexico in his own image while pushing a harmful agenda that would cut SNAP, universal childcare, and Medicaid and drive up costs for working families. His policies continue to make New Mexicans hungrier, sicker, and poorer—and we cannot afford to have a Republican in Santa Fe like my opponent who will rubber-stamp Trump’s agenda.
| | [Chip In Now >>](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/17387?refcode=jtk1586-fr-nd&t=3&akid=13322%2E400544%2EM2OAIH)
---
We need a governor who will stand up to Trump’s extremism and focus on what matters to New Mexicans: lowering costs, protecting healthcare, creating good-paying jobs, strengthening our schools, and preserving what makes our state unique. _**I’ve stood up to Donald Trump before, and won.**_
**But let’s be clear: With just 15 days until Election Day, Trump is trying to distract New Mexicans from what’s really at stake: his extreme agenda on the ballot in New Mexico. **My Republican opponent is ready to carry it out, with cuts to SNAP, universal childcare, and Medicaid while families face higher costs.
That’s why a Trump-aligned super PAC has spent over $800,000 in New Mexico to help Republicans win up and down the ballot. Meanwhile, my opponent has already accepted half a million dollars from Trump’s MAGA donors. They’re spending big to force Trump’s agenda onto our communities, and we need your urgent help to fight back.
**And let’s be VERY clear:** New Mexico’s elections are not “crooked.” _Trump is attacking them because New Mexicans have voted against him every single time he’s been on the ballot._ Our elections are secure, and New Mexicans deserve to have their voices heard. That’s why we must make our voices heard this November—but I need your help to make that happen.
**That’s why we’re reaching out to you, friend:[We cannot allow a Trump-aligned candidate to be New Mexico’s next Governor, and that is exactly who my opponent is ready to be. Will you rush $5 right now to help ensure we have the resources we need for the next 15 days to help me win this November so I can keep New Mexico, New Mexico and fight for working families?](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/17392?refcode=jtk1586-fr-nd&t=4&akid=13322%2E400544%2EM2OAIH)**

| | Friend, Eight days before the election, Ilhan Omar is headlining an event in Minnesota to turn out Democrats and help all of their candidates, including Jake Johnson.**Her special guest is Hasan Piker.** If you haven’t heard of him, he’s a far-left internet streamer with millions of young followers. He once said on his stream that _America deserved 9/11._ He has made appalling remarks about Jewish Americans that members of his own party have called antisemitic.That’s who Ilhan Omar and Omar Fateh, the Democratic Socialist who ran for mayor of Minneapolis, are putting on stage October 26.**The RSVP list filled up in five minutes.** Even some Democrats can’t stomach it. Angie Craig, who represents the district next to ours, called Piker’s rhetoric “polarizing and dangerous” and said embracing him is a mistake. No surprise Jake Johnson has been silent on it, wanting the benefit of more Democrats turning out for him. Ilhan Omar doesn’t care. She has already campaigned with Piker in Wisconsin. Now she is bringing him to Minnesota to help Minnesota Democrats.**So what does an event in Minneapolis have to do with southern Minnesota?** **Everything.** National Democrats say flipping our seat is key to winning back the House. That’s why the DCCC put us on its Red to Blue target list and is coordinating millions in attack ads. That’s why they’ve been pouring in dark money against our campaign. If they win the majority, Ilhan Omar and her wing of the party get more power in Washington. Not less. Jake Johnson wants to be part of that majority. He should tell voters the truth about the radical left wing support he keeps benefiting from.Here’s the hard truth. Their side is fired up. They’re using influencers and rallies to turn out every voter they can find, and early voting is already open.We have to match that energy. **Will you chip in today to help us turn out our voters before November 3?**

I'm a professional ski mountaineer from Park City, and in 2024 I ran for the U.S. Senate in Utah. Most days, I write about public lands, clean air, and how our democracy works. Today I need to write about Russia.
Caroline Gleich ⛰️ is a reader-supported publication. To receive new posts and support my work, consider becoming a free or paid subscriber.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..z0sVH5azPXMhvjVZjAYMI1uxIAd9IXmLsYKJ8ph_Nqk?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=221245102)
This is part of my Systems Check series, where we look under the hood of our government and ask who it's really working for. This week, the answer scared me.
In America, the work I do makes me an activist. In Vladimir Putin's Russia, it would make me a criminal.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ce6f7c7e-3662-4cb9-8ecd-ad50b796d14f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
I travel the world, and I work with people and groups in many countries. In Russia, that alone could get me branded a "foreign agent." I'd have to stamp that label on every single post, like a scarlet letter.
I talk about climate change, and I call out the oil and gas industry. In 2023, Russia banned the World Wildlife Fund for doing the same thing. The government said its campaigns against oil and gas were holding back the economy. Greenpeace got banned that same year, and its Russian office shut down.
I help people vote, and I watch for problems at the polls. Russia's biggest independent election watchdog has exposed cheating in every major Russian election since 2000. Its leader, Grigory Melkonyants, got five years in prison.
I ran for Senate against the party in power. Putin's biggest critic, Alexei Navalny, was blocked from running for president. He was poisoned with a nerve agent, survived, and went home anyway. He died in an Arctic prison in 2024.
And this post? In Russia, calling the war in Ukraine a**war** could get me up to 15 years. Instagram, where many of you found me, is banned there.
Russia has jailed Americans for much less. Ksenia Karelina, a dual citizen from Los Angeles, was sentenced to 12 years for treason after donating about $51 to a Ukrainian charity. She came home in a 2025 prisoner swap. Her story is why I won't be traveling to Russia for a long, long time.
In the mountains, we talk about high consequence terrain. That's ground where one small slip can kill you. In Putin's Russia, every honest sentence is high consequence terrain.
## Who Vladimir Putin is
Putin used to be an officer in the KGB, the Soviet Union's secret police. He has run Russia for more than 25 years. In 2020, he changed the rules so he can stay in power until 2036.
He runs Russia the way a mob boss runs a neighborhood. Journalists who dug into his government have been murdered. Critics end up poisoned, in prison, or dead. Russia still holds elections, but when the boss picks the candidates and counts the votes, it's a show and not a choice.
Putin once called the fall of the Soviet Union the greatest disaster of the century. In 2021, he wrote a long essay claiming Russians and Ukrainians are one people. Seven months later, his tanks rolled into Ukraine.
Putin didn't stay in power by winning arguments. He stayed in power by making disagreement too dangerous.
## Who Ukraine is
In 1994, Ukraine had the third biggest pile of nuclear weapons on Earth. It gave them all up. In return, the United States, Britain, and Russia promised to respect its borders. Then Russia kicked in the door.
Russia grabbed Crimea in 2014 and invaded the rest of Ukraine in 2022. Researchers estimate close to 2 million soldiers on both sides have been killed, wounded, or gone missing. Ukraine says Russia has taken 19,546 Ukrainian children, and the International Criminal Court issued an arrest warrant for Putin over it.
Ukraine isn't perfect, and no country is. If Russia stops fighting, the war ends. If Ukraine stops fighting, Ukraine ends.
## One week in October
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ed5f35a1-ae9f-4665-b48b-5a3fd14ad1fb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Putin is the man our president spent last week cozying up to. Here's Trump's calendar.
**October 9.** Trump got off the phone with Putin and announced a deal to buy Russian diesel. Russia pays for its war by selling fuel, so this is a refill on Putin's tank.
**October 10.** Trump said Ukraine needs a new leader.
**October 11.** Trump announced an "energy ceasefire." Hours later, Russian drones hit a power plant in Kyiv.
**That same week.** Ukraine's military satellite service slowed down without warning. It's called Starshield, the military version of Starlink, and our government pays for it. Ukraine uses it to fly the drones that shoot down Russian attack drones before they hit apartment buildings. Some missions failed. Reuters reported that the order came from inside the White House. The Telegraph reported that Elon Musk proposed the limits and Trump approved them. The White House denies it.
**October 16.** Trump waived new Russia sanctions that Congress passed with support from both parties, two days before they took effect. The head of Putin's investment fund called it historic.
## "But it's about diesel prices"
Diesel costs are a real squeeze for truckers and farmers. But the first shipment of Russian diesel is roughly half a day of what America uses. Twelve senators from both parties called the deal a gift to our adversary.
## Russia, Iran, and our troops
Russia is Iran's ally. This year, Russian satellite intelligence helped Iran hit American bases, and the Pentagon counts $3.7 billion in lost equipment. When a reporter asked Trump about Russia helping Iran, he called it a stupid question.
In a Chicago Council poll, 69 percent of Americans wanted more sanctions on Russia, including 69 percent of Republicans.
## **Why every American should be angry**
Vladimir Putin is wanted for war crimes. Our president gave him a diesel deal and a pass on sanctions. Then he thanked him. On camera, our president said, 'I want to thank President Putin.'
It's also about our word. America helped convince Ukraine to give up its nuclear weapons. If we turn our backs now, every country watching learns that giving up nukes is a mistake, and the world gets more dangerous for all of us.
# What you can do
Call your senators at 202-224-3121 and tell them to enforce the Russia sanctions law. Then vote for leaders who stand up to dictators instead of doing them favors.
If this helped, share it with one friend and tell me in the comments what you're hearing from your senators. Subscribe for more Systems Check.

body:

| | | | | | We got our hands on a new poll of the governor’s race this week. Deb Haaland is ahead, but there’s a number inside the poll about her own party that her campaign will not want you to see.
Meanwhile, [KRQE posted a headline](https://us.list-manage.com/15c0juk2hkG?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e) about the race that was so slanted it had to come down. We show it to you, along with what viewers had to say about it.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/mN_q04ICl5b?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| | **📊 EXCLUSIVE POLL: HAALAND LEADS HULL, BUT HER OWN PARTY ISN’T SOLD**
We got an early look at a new poll of the governor’s race. Deb Haaland is ahead, but the race is closer than a lot of people think.
The surprise is how many Democrats still aren’t on board with her, with three weeks to go. We also show you how both candidates have changed since the summer, now that the attack ads are running.
---
| [STREAM NOW](https://us.list-manage.com/14_pieDOwhO?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
| | **📺 KRQE ASKED IF HULL WOULD “SERVE TRUMP,” THEN DELETED IT**
On Sunday morning, KRQE posted a headline about the governor’s race. Viewers piled on so fast that the station pulled it within hours.
There was a time when that headline would never have made it past the news desk. We talk about what changed at the station, and we read some of the comments. None of them were kind.

**🏛️ GABE VASQUEZ FINALLY ANSWERED FOR THE “DEFUND THE POLICE” MASK**
For years, Vasquez never said whether he was the man in the mask in that video. At the CD2 debate on KRQE, Greg Cunningham kept asking until he got an answer.
We play the exchange, count the dodges, and lay out how a first-time challenger can break a polished incumbent.
---
| [STREAM NOW](https://us.list-manage.com/16u8z32bbo5?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
| | **PLUS:** The early vote numbers are in, and the gap between the parties tells you a lot about election night. Michele Tafoya took apart Peggy Flanagan on Minnesota’s fraud scandal. Troy Jackson’s answer about Iran on CNN did not go well. Katie Zacharia is already out as press secretary, and we show you the Hannity interview that sealed it.

We also have a new golden retriever, and he still needs a name!

* $6 diesel squeezing Kansas farmers
* Harmful tariffs hurting small businesses
* Endless wars raising the costs of everyday goods for families
* The decision to slash SNAP benefits and Medicaid that Kansans rely on

name: Roy
subject: An update and a special request
body:
We can’t afford to be drowned out.
| [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1703&source=&t=1&akid=4734%2E124072%2EBxBLOx) | | | |
---
Peter,
**Tomorrow, President Trump will hold a MAGA rally for Michael Whatley here in North Carolina – all to fire up their base and spread more lies and distortions about me. Trump is following up on his relentless and false Truth Social attacks against my record.**
We set a goal to raise $1 million to fight back against whatever attacks they throw our way, but as of now, we’re on track to fall short. With just 15 days left until Election Day and Senate control on the line, we can’t afford to be drowned out – but if we miss this goal, that’s exactly what will happen.
I’m running a grassroots campaign, fueled by $5 and $10 donations from people like you, and this is a big moment for us. I need folks who understand the stakes of this race to rush their support before it’s too late.
**Please, Peter, will you send me a donation of any amount to help us reach our critical goal, flip NC blue and take back the Senate for the people?**
**My team and I will be tracking donations at this link – thank you:[_https:/ /secure.actblue.com/donate/cooper_](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1703&amount=5&t=8&akid=4734%2E124072%2EBxBLOx)**
I’m grateful to have you by my side in this fight.
Roy Cooper

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.

****
2.** Republicans see this race as a **top pickup opportunity,** especially knowing New Mexico’s governorship tends to flip parties every eight years.

**3.** Deb’s Republican opponent is bankrolled by many of Trump’s TOP supporters in New Mexico and is focused on bringing Trump’s extremism to New Mexico.
Between now and Election Day, keeping our ads on TV, traveling across New Mexico, organizing events, and reaching voters takes real resources. **And the closer we get to Election Day, the more quickly those decisions and investments have to be made.** _None of us want to look back the morning after Election Day wishing we’d done a little more. That’s why you’re hearing from us again — because what happens right now will shape what we’re able to do in the final stretch. name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
subject: What it feels like to be governed by billionaires.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
Out of all of the issues in politics, one of the most important ones for us to tackle is our corrupt campaign finance system.
And the reason that issue is so important is because it is the one that impacts almost every single piece of legislation that comes before Congress.
Somehow, we have conditioned ourselves as a country to accept the idea that defense companies, drug companies, fossil fuel companies, technology companies and more can spend billions and billions of dollars to impact the outcome of our elections in order to get the legislation they want... most often to enrich themselves.
Does it matter if the result is more endless war? Higher drug prices? The impacts of climate change ravaging our planet? Technology that threatens the future of our civilization?
No, it does not.
And the outcome that we are all living with is what it feels like to be governed by billionaires. The result is oligarchy.
Not someday.
Not in theory.
Right now.
And I am here to tell you that we don't have to live like this anymore.
We can make a new world, a better country, where we can fight for the dignity of all people. And that dignity looks like living wages; It looks like stable housing; It looks like guaranteed healthcare and respect for all of our differences, no matter who we are or where we come from.
That is what I am working toward every day.
But that work also requires resources.
Now, I fund those efforts differently than most.
I am not running around the country begging billionaires for campaign contributions. Our work is funded by lots and lots of people making individual donations when they can, for whatever amount they can.
**And that is what I am asking you to do today -- to add one more donation to help power our work.**
I know some of you may be thinking: Alexandria, you aren't in the most competitive district this general election, why are you asking for money?
Fair question. Here's the answer:
The donations we do receive go toward things like the organizers we've hired in Tennessee to help elect Justin J. Pearson to Congress -- and in Florida to help elect Angie Nixon to the United States Senate.
The donations we receive go toward events and travel when you see us holding things like the Fighting Oligarchy Tour, or my time last weekend supporting Abdul El-Sayed in Michigan and Emilia Sykes in her competitive House race in Ohio.
The donations we receive sometimes go toward donations we make to candidates like Chris Rabb in Pennsylvania before he won his primary -- and they go toward worthy causes like the Northeast Bronx Community Farmers Market Project or the Bronx River Houses Residents Association.
That is why I ask.
It's often not even for me -- even though we are under constant threat of attack from billionaires who would love nothing more than to kick me out of Congress.
They go toward the movement.
Because the only way to beat a machine is with a movement.
So for one of the last times before this election, I am asking:
[ Can you please make a contribution to my campaign today? Our average donation is around $16. Some give more. Some give less. The amount of the donation isn't nearly as important as the number of people chipping in to support our work. ](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-26-q4.h3BeQC&refcode=em20261020-12451-P_FND_EXP_MIS&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=12451%2E2526796%2ELNRg94)
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-26-q4.h3BeQC&refcode=em20261020-12451-P_FND_EXP_MIS&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&akid=12451%2E2526796%2ELNRg94)**
Thank you for your continued support.
In solidarity,
Alexandria

**[Donate](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-26-q4.h3BeQC&refcode=em20261020-12451-P_FND_EXP_MIS&t=1&akid=12451%2E2526796%2ELNRg94)** | **[Merch](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/9251?utm_source=em-footer-20261020-12451-P_FND_EXP_MIS&t=2&akid=12451%2E2526796%2ELNRg94)**

The donations we receive go toward events and travel when you see us holding things like the Fighting Oligarchy Tour, or my time last weekend supporting Abdul El-Sayed in Michigan and Emilia Sykes in her competitive House race in Ohio. The donations we receive sometimes go toward donations we make to candidates like Chris Rabb in Pennsylvania before he won his primary -- and they go toward worthy causes like the Northeast Bronx Community Farmers Market Project or the Bronx River Houses Residents Association. That is why I ask. It's often not even for me -- even though we are under constant threat of attack from billionaires who would love nothing more than to kick me out of Congress. They go toward the movement. Because the only way to beat a machine is with a movement. So for one of the last times before this election, I am asking: Thank you for your continued support. In solidarity, Alexandria | ---|--- | | | ---|---|---|--- Email us: mailto: speak@ocasiocortez.com

name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: The President is coming after me… again
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN
body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=2522%2E135344%2ER0VSon)

Folks -
Last week, I was at the University of Chicago and said that if Democrats win back the House and the Senate, we should be intentional with how we hold the President and his administration accountable for the many ways they have broken the law. My message is not complicated: If you break the law, then you should be held accountable. If you are stealing taxpayer money and enriching President Trump or his family, then you should be held accountable.
Those comments have since kicked off a highly coordinated right-wing media play – led by Republican politicians and online MAGA grifters. Millions of views. A wave of new threats to my life and doxxing my staff on the internet. Most recently, President Trump himself weighed in, attacking me in personal terms.
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-26.79HKre&refcode=em260823&t=2&akid=2522%2E135344%2ER0VSon)
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-26.79HKre&refcode=em260823&t=3&akid=2522%2E135344%2ER0VSon)
Why is all this happening? It seems I touched a nerve. I pointed out the blatant corruption that the American people can see with their own eyes. The average person understands that the President is enriching himself and using taxpayer dollars to do it. And there needs to be accountability for it.
Unfortunately, this isn't my first rodeo with President Trump. Nearly a year ago, he called for me to be arrested, tried, and hanged for a 90 second video he didn't like, where I reminded the U.S. military of their oath to the Constitution.
This is what they do: they take something that hits a nerve, they manufacture outrage, they gin themselves up to a froth to distract, and they try to intimidate you out of speaking the truth.
They want you to be small and stop talking – so we have to do the opposite.
The goal is to crush your spirit and to threaten you into silence.
I won’t stop pointing out the extraordinary level of corruption this President is committing every day from the Oval Office. It’s not the America we know, and it’s not the America we are going to be. We must must be a nation of laws.
Thank you for standing with us. We won’t back down.
**[CONTRIBUTE NOW](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-26.79HKre&refcode=em260823&t=4&akid=2522%2E135344%2ER0VSon)**
Elissa

PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN
P.O. Box 211
Southfield, MI 48037
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is a very important way we communicate with supporters like you, but if you want to, you can [ unsubscribe here](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/unsubscribe/unsubscribe?t=5&akid=2522%2E135344%2ER0VSon).

name: Abdul El-Sayed
subject: Millions of eyes are on us after a recent town hall
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Abdul for U
body:
[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/1219?t=1001&akid=3649%2E251025%2EEdkTxN ]Abdul for US Senate [ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/1219?t=1002&akid=3649%2E251025%2EEdkTxN ]Abdul for US Senate

Peter, at a recent
town hall, a man named Tommy asked me this:

“Will you disavow the Muslim Brotherhood?”

I said, “Yeah, absolutely.” Then I asked him why he was asking me this.

You already know the answer. He assumed that because I’m Muslim, my
loyalty must belong to something other than the Constitution.

I reminded Tommy that John F. Kennedy got asked whether he'd have
allegiance to the Pope, because he was Catholic. Same question, same
assumption.

Peter, I’m
not running to be a Muslim senator. I’m running for the U.S. Senate, and I
happen to be Muslim. The Constitution is my guiding light, and I’ll fight
to protect the right to pray or not pray as you choose for all Americans,
including Tommy.

That clip has been viewed more than *44 million times* online. I think it
went viral because of how perfectly it captures a core aspect of this
race:

Republicans are attacking my faith because they have nothing else to run
on.

Michiganders are paying too much for groceries, gas, and healthcare. And
Mike Rogers has no real solutions to those issues. He’s simply running to
be an errand boy for Donald Trump.

So the same weekend as that town hall, Rogers ramped up his baseless
Muslim Brotherhood attacks, and Donald Trump continued to mispronounce my
name and try twisting it into a punchline. They’re betting that if they
make voters afraid of me, nobody will notice who’s actually been robbing
them.

But a viral clip isn’t enough. With two weeks to go, Michigan voters need
to hear the truth from us before the GOP’s attacks reach them.

[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20261020-1-ak.G7Rz9k&amount=10&refcode=em20261020-3642&t=1004&akid=3649%2E251025%2EEdkTxN ]Can you chip in $10 or any amount so our message is the
loudest thing Michigan voters hear, not MAGA’s fearmongering?

[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20261020-1-ak.G7Rz9k&amount=10&refcode=em20261020-3642&t=1023&akid=3649%2E251025%2EEdkTxN ]Donate $10 ››

In solidarity,

Abdul

Michiganders are paying too much for groceries, gas, and healthcare. And Mike Rogers has no real solutions to those issues. He’s simply running to be an errand boy for Donald Trump. So the same weekend as that town hall, Rogers ramped up his baseless Muslim Brotherhood attacks, and Donald Trump continued to mispronounce my name and try twisting it into a punchline. They’re betting that if they make voters afraid of me, nobody will notice who’s actually been robbing them. But a viral clip isn’t enough. With two weeks to go, Michigan voters need to hear the truth from us before the GOP’s attacks reach them. ## Trump to France: 'Close the Borders, Fast'
President Trump urged France to "[CLOSE THE BORDERS, FAST](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2OqzAUhJ8GOiP_AXHh4jZ0ue2WyJjjxCuD0fFZnLz9irzCdjMaaTTffN3nu4sp7o__bgNLIc871JKACHA-HMbifzBALejeZUGogKXmWXI5MMGZ5LPzFE-YtWtXGwAkqBasGI3Uhg-Ct0-7jqB96G9LfwsjH8NNiV4H44xQmiup2mivPsElF5wraTpjhA_aOcWH3vWjaDSHNVLG7jvHnZ4Q0jufgJ3PW5vsk-gojfrXyKmRU621C_l1cVx5I6cUT2CXb-T0YWIB3e6BYcxU2IGZoFBh8CKELV4yH7CzJeMKWBgk8BTzXlj2lBdAJkyLdj1qTCmWYWw0f2wups8e-uONp5W_AQAA__9JpIsi)" on Monday after a weekend of rioting left nearly 1,000 police officers injured, about 2,400 people under arrest, and at least 3,000 businesses damaged. _" The migrants have taken over France,"_ he wrote on Truth Social. Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu ordered [overnight curfews](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2O5CAQhJ8GZ1jQ_jsCgkuczaUXWr24GbPCxmrwoHn7lVf7BptUVPpU9f1_LA8MMRzPf7iTLT4tB9UcqRTi5UQO2V3sqWbGd_5gqsS5pgUUjFIrCWpBV8KLlh6b1XoioK4hqycDvVGjVs1m8Q_A4GE02FE_rDhOCpxx5FbdjX2nmmBvnlagtFIdmNYY7XyP2KlxwGHSole0hpK4_UzhKBv5-E4v4talvYl2K-XMovsrYBYw11pbujjdR-6CgPnGC5i1usMImD3T4TZ57jKSS3xc0mGMWfrEkukZ0oFR4lW2xKEEyrIkGfYzZZIncgkY5Y-Xhu161hBjyOMkevXcMcTvXeWXOl8WvgIAAP__HqWL3w) in parts of Paris and several northern cities, blaming "ultra-left" groups. President Emmanuel Macron refused to accept his interior minister's resignation, even after the minister admitted police had "lost control" in some cities. Some 550,000 people marched Saturday. Rioters gutted the 19th-century city hall in Limoges, torched Lyon's tourist office, and smashed luxury boutiques in Paris. [See photos here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL3u3CAQxJ8Gd7aWxR-hoEjj7tKmtPbwcibCxgLO6N4-8r3Cv5liRvqNZv4-lgf54I_XH9rZFBeXg2sOXAqn5aTks30nxzUn-uRn4sop17gg4NhKaBEWssVfvPTUrMYxI6uGjZw09hpGCc1mejVKqyYYBnZPnDQNkkbUSiFN46-1b7y5eRIQJIBC3WktreuJFIwDDZMUPfDqS0zdv-iPsrELn3hx6mzcm2C2Us4s1G-Bs8C51trZ42nvUOB8owXOEm7RAmeX6LDcnikWziW335Xt5WPgr-9teSfO3Vb20CSzntWH4PM4iR5eO_nwbS0_POsy-D8AAP__bot-IQ). Not everyone was rattled. A couple was filmed [sharing a drink and a cigarette](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDGOwyAQRU-DOyIYY2wKim3cZdstrYk9JGQxWEBi-fYr5wrbTDP6T_-_n-t0RR98vH_jSra6NEXaS6BaKU8bZl_mV3a0l4xHuWXaKZc9TSBAcyk4iAnn6t80KWwW64iA2oas7A0oI7QUzcN26DSqgZRwEpQaWtN2Ri_DYHqhle4bb0-eFCCkEC2YizFydgqxFbrDrpdMCVp8TfnyTD7WB7lwpDfly5zWJthHrVth7ReDkcEYjy2Ver4YjCeYwSjFeQyDcU85LPwcyWCc02sLxH3kLmOciTsfVlo4xWc6fLxz5Ev28Zdj4R8Z_PbK8Uw22S7b7kPwRfdMifuKPnzq1H9afFv4CwAA__-GeIYN) at a bistro table near the Arc de Triomphe as fires burned behind them, and a jogger wove past burning e-bikes. The Louvre closed Monday, and unions have called a nationwide strike for Nov. 5.
## Musk Pledges Stock Giveaways to Kids
Elon Musk said Monday he will give one of his SpaceX shares to [every child in America](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGupCAYBeCnwQ7zA46MBcU2drPtluYXf0Z2UAwwcuftb7yvcJvTnOQ7yfn3mB7og9-ff3EjU1ycdqo5UCmUpgOTz_adHNWc8JPnRJVSrnGSIHsugEuY0BZ_0tRhsxhHJEk1ZIQeZDdAL6BZzayg71FpO1vXae3QzkrfAfVyB4H63nhzeQIkCAAlh3YYhHUdooL-hjctWAe0-BJT-z_6vazkwieelFobtyaYtZQjM_WHyZHJsdba2n22V8nkeNFMjgKuGJgcKcSdb-_84vlAS188r5go86c_CSt--MsvuV3LFppklqP6EHzuNevguaEPP5vll1edRn4HAAD__zfufeQ) next year, a pledge worth roughly $10.5 billion at Friday's closing price of $146.03. _" Next year, I will give one of my SpaceX shares to every kid in America. This will be the first of many,"_ he [wrote on X](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DGy2yAQgOHToM6e3RVCpqBIo85pU2pWaLFJkPAAtuLbv_G7wmv_4iv-P9f5yjHF_fabN3Et5HmXoyZpTcr84BKrf5YgRy38rkuRQ0o98kxA5oRwIpjZt_iSWXO3uiBC0nficLSkLRiE7u5GkpEXYaO1cAirN4toe0Hv2ehhMV10Hw-BAAF6smdr0QfN3IMZeBhRaZA1tlzOf3Pc211CeueXlLPPW5fcvbVHVf0vRZOi6f-nKpok5X171n-Kptq4PauiiRAJLnYYjMEBqUfUXXHr44gpxWpGpeG2cUzfcPvhj5ejrwAAAP__wbhzZQ), without saying how the shares would be distributed or who counts as a kid. The post answered a Sunday announcement from AI developer Anthropic, which committed [5% of its shares](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGSpCAURb9GMyxAW4uAYBOz3nRD64mXlh0EC2jp_vupnl-Y_Natc86_-3In5114_KUDuti4BNTsUQrSclJy2TyTRc2J3nlNqEi5xkVyOTLBmeQLmeIuLAO1m7aARN9Ci0nJQfFR8HbXalUWStnRklVqkxwTRkg-bBAj3dbW6c-f4JILznupOqWEsQNRz8cb3SbRDBybKzF1_6MLZYf173ghdSYerdd7KWdu-j-NnBs511o7G1_rM7uAnD-bRs42vthHjRWYvZEzfAzseOYvlk8yeLG8U0JmdCA5Q4GZ3fktIbCHu0CV3m3S21md9y6PUzPwx0HO_xCUX4a7tPwOAAD__-CkhuU) to a new Public Benefit Fund, with over 1% more for every 50% rise in the company's value. Musk had replied that Anthropic should give the shares "directly to the public" instead. Both companies are under scrutiny over AI's effect on jobs, and Anthropic is preparing a stock listing that could value it above $1 trillion. The Census Bureau counts about 72 million Americans under 18, and SpaceX stock [rose more than 2%](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2ypCAUhJ8GMyz-xDEg2MTsbrqhdQYP49lBmAKurm-_NfMKN-ugu-ur78_X8gUUKT1-w46uhbwkPGvE1rAsLyhU_XcJeNYCV70XPLHUMy9KKMul4Eos4BsduBjoVhcQFeoOnRwnZSZhpeg2Z7TR2pgbinWQNoRxnO528Dcr7jcbjOrIvf-kUEIKodXUT5P0wQBoYQcYRsmMwJVaLv3fTKltGOKVDyy9z3sX3dbaqzL9i6mZqTlQguSxv2DL-d1gat6hPLFVpubasn--A5RGPiJTM8ac-P5dn7zCVfmGlT_ooPTg9QUe__HPhrfM8cBy8SetnBKHHQt54FJLowdjx35re-yKW18nxUjVjsyIxw4UP5zth3oPp_4HAAD__wWbkPQ) in early Monday trading.
## 1 in 3 Weddings Now Last Three Days
Nearly one in three American weddings now [stretches across three days](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L9y8yAQBPCnQZ00x-kfKii-Rp2_NiVzhsMmg4UHiInfPqO8QpptdudX7MfFXCjEcNz-04N19ckc3ErkWjmbJ-VQ7Ff23Eqmd7lmbpxLSwYBl15Cj2DI1vBiM1HntGdGHjvWct1w2mCR0N01gxstk6WrhFmpcUallFoXJPLeurUL-vQkIEiAEbdh26T1E9EIy0zzKsUE7EJNefhM4ah39vGdXpwHmx5d1Pdan0WM_wTuAvfW2kDfIZWzFbiftsBdwhnqHLBz4bj1NfPhSo-Aa5e1e7YQYyjLKia4PSjEX73-8ZSXxp8AAAD__5EKdPs) or more, according to a new report from The Knot, as couples turn the big day into a weekend of welcome dinners, ceremonies, and day-after brunches. The wedding-planning site’s annual trends report, drawn from the planning habits of [1.7 million U.S. couples](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFugzAURb8GNqPnh4EweOjClq4d0Yv9HNwaG9lOUP6-Sn-h2x2ujo7O13W9kg8-3j9pZ11dWiOfJXCtnNeDsi_mkR2fJdOr3DKfnMuZVgQchQSBsJKp_smrotZqx4zct6zlNKOaYZTQbnrCydobkzKXy4DW2lEZ18MwqstgrLKt12-eBAQJ0OPczbM0ThH1MA40TLJRwNbXlLvv5GPd2IVXenLuTNrboLdaj9L0Hw0uDS7OR4qGuxdtKb0fDS5lpxDE7VF85FIaXChXbwK_509MVSDgJE621se7qJmjLSLzkXIVsgcA6NXUbXUPbdb2OH0IvoxTo-C-kw9_HvWf-Z4afwMAAP__XOmFxw), found searches for coastal Italian “beach club” weddings up 315% from a year ago. Antique lace searches are up 280%, and silver flatware and cool-toned decor searches are up 133%. Food is becoming the entertainment, with searches for roaming caviar, oyster, and cannoli carts [up 66%](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFu6yAUgOGnwZutw7FDxMBwF2-5a0cLwyGmJRDBqVHevkpfofMvfcP_cdtuNqaY7__tgwyHsmXqLREz1e1pa2zuuwbqrdpX2yt1qq2XDQHVKGFE2KzjeNK22MGbQIQ0D2TkVeOiQUkYDqOIggtBqd3LsEt0DvY9WLJaao8KhmjengQECTCjnrSWLizWzqAu9nKVYgHykUudPkvMfFBIr3JSnVx5DMkczM8m5n8CV4Fr733ig75y4XcXuLqSmTILXDP1sZP3Md9HrpR9G6rxzx5Tik1dxQL3h43p1-U_7jgN_gQAAP__SWR3Yw). Couples are also registering for camcorders, record players, and old-fashioned cocktail glasses. All of it adds up. Wedding spending was [up 8.5%](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD1uhDAQRk9jOpBt_pbCRRq6TZsSDfYYJjE2smcX7e2jzRXSfcWn96T3dV_uQIHi9gkHGvZpiXiVgMyYlxMyFfvIHq-S4VXWjBfmcqVFSz3UStZaLmCZnrh0UDnjETW2FRo1Trqb5KBktRvd3trR9agH76cRAaUDXNebGrxF5fqKzJunpJZKylZPzTQp6zuAVg499KMSnURHnHLznSjyjj680hNzY9NRBbMzn0W0H0LPQs8UCxM_GJsV4k_ycGAmC--v0DPaFNNBtqZYaNu5CD1f6BzFrS4nxvdodj5ClY07LwqByjCKTm4HUPgT8j87PY3-DQAA__9FBoDJ) through May this year, according to Bank of America card data. The Knot’s editorial director told the media that couples’ “No. 1 priority is now the guest experience.”

Let me lay out the facts of the race for you.
There are 14 days until the polls close. And unlike most other states, the vast majority of New Hampshire voters cast their ballot on Election Day.

We're being massively outspent, and every decision we make now could be the margin between a win and a loss.
I've been here before -- I've won four times in one of the "swingiest" districts in the country. To win the whole Granite State, I know I'll need you with me. New Hampshire voters are still making up their minds, and we have to stay competitive these last few weeks.
**[We're running out of time, and I need your help today. Will you chip in $15 today to help power our campaign through to November 3rd?](https://substack.com/redirect/e589ee17-d252-483d-a0d0-5cd364020d9a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

Every dollar you contribute right now will help reach voters across New Hampshire during the most important part of this race.
Thank you,
Chris

name: Tim Burchett
subject: The UniParty doesn’t want you reading this
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Burchett for Congress
body:
Will you chip in just $5 right now and help me keep fighting the DC establishment?

| [](https://trk.email.tim-burchett.)
---
Ever wonder why the government just keeps getting bigger and more expensive - even when Republicans are supposed to be in charge?
I’ll tell you why: It’s the whole dadgum UniParty swamp in Washington.
[Folks come up here, puff their chest out on TV, act like they’re in some big fight... and then they slip behind closed doors and cut deals that grow the same bloated government they promised to shrink.](https://trk.email.tim-burchett.-JrO0ig)
Different jerseys. Same playbook: [Spend more. Grow the machine. Protect their own.](https://trk.email.tim-burchett._ow)
You’ll see Republicans vote for the same big spending mess they campaign against back home.
But have you ever seen Democrats meet us halfway on conservative priorities? Not in your lifetime.
That’s how the swamp keeps rolling - like a broken-down carnival ride nobody wants to fix because everybody’s making money off the tickets.
[I don’t fit in with that crowd, and I don’t plan to. I didn’t come up here to join the club. I came here to fight it.](https://trk.email.tim-burchett._B1JQvGZhw)
But standing up to that kind of machine? That ain’t cheap, and it sure ain’t easy.
They’ve got lobbyists, donors, backroom deals - the whole setup. I’ve got a backbone... and I’ve got patriots like you, Peter.
So I’m asking you straight: [Will you chip in just $5 right now and help me keep fighting the DC establishment?](https://trk.email.tim-burchett.)
---
| [CHIP IN NOW](https://trk.email.tim-burchett.)
---
I’m not playing along with the sewer rats. Not now. Not ever.
Thank y’all for sending me here,Tim Burchett

I was 12 years old, homeless, and living in a tent. It wasn’t easy, but it made me tough. Folks, by the time I was in middle school, I had been a frequent flier with children’s services. I had lived in over a dozen homes and experienced abuse, hunger, and homelessness. But I was determined to find a way out. I credit public schools with saving my life. And I worked three jobs in college and medical school to fulfill my dream of becoming a doctor. **I’m not sharing this story to earn sympathy points. I’m sharing it because these experiences shaped who I am and how I fight.** They’re why I’ll never look the other way while Ohio families struggle to afford groceries, healthcare, childcare, or a place to call home. I know what it’s like to need someone to fight for you. **That’s why I’m running for governor.** Look, there’s no doubt this will be a tough fight. I’m up against an out-of-touch billionaire who has no idea what it’s like to struggle. He’s spending tens of millions to buy this state for his own selfish gain. **But I’m ready for a tough fight. And if I learned anything from my childhood, it’s that no one gets through anything alone. That’s where you come in, folks.** **[Together, I know we can build a future for Ohio that works for everyone. So if you’re ready to fight for that future and defeat an out-of-touch billionaire, then I’m asking for just $3 today. ## Musk Pledges SpaceX Stock for Kids
Elon Musk pledged Monday to give one of his own SpaceX shares to "[every kid in America](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDuO4zAQRE8jZTKaP1MKGGzizJtuKLTIpkUsJRFk-zO3H2iuMGGhgEK99-8-3zHltD_-4kaOP_GYd3q3TMxU58bIFDHVd8XyLFj92jjl3GYJ8joIGCTM6Dm9aNbYB7dAmERPTthJ6kkLMfars1pTnKz1Vo1GXMkGoYSJMQo1eVxCn9w5J0CCECCMvmiMPqDSeoowRjN2GigkPuqFV2L6YIv563hRvfhj67NbmUvr1J9O3jp5w3IinNUZKiefqZO37dn-D62gp8-AO6_1KMkP4diR07EPmIZFKSEDKotASsNC0ho5GbAKjCGAvrpQ3inn1K620_DYMOWfC_xbdS8nvwMAAP__5NGC7Q)" next year, a gift worth more than $10 billion at Friday's closing price. Musk announced it on X, writing, "_This will be the first of many_." He didn't say which ages would qualify or how the shares would be distributed, though [he could use Trump Accounts](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGSozAQRL9GZKIkIcAOFFxCtpdeSI2lkZlCIEqaxebvr7y_sFkH3V2v3r-v-Qso0f78Cxs6fsc87_iqCZmxzJWBMQKVV4Hj-4Dil8qUUp2NMoPUSho1g2c6cbbQBPdQ4a4bdHq8G3u3Wt-axY3-ZnAc_aMbgu37AKaL0UaMwwiDfeiG3OdOK6O0Vrq3rYXoA3TW3qO6xf4mrMJAnEvLCzK-ocZ05RNL6_PWJLcwH1V0f4SZhJki7bB7bC9Ycv40hJk2KCtyFWaqnP36CVCYfEJhJkx5l9t3XWWFq8oFq3zSSftT1gM8vuXPRnKWeGK55EpB0i5hw0IepO607Xo7jO3CW2qKC8eLUqI6jMKq5waUfjj5t35PZ_4HAAD__8BKkwM), the new investment accounts for children. The pledge came a day after AI company Anthropic said it would commit [5% of its shares](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL1uhDAQhJ_GdEa2MRwULtLQXdqUaLHXhxXzI-_ecXn7iLxCupFGmtH3fd2nO6SctscnrOj4Hfdpw5MyMmOZiIExQipngeN5QPELccqZJqNMJ7WSRk3gOb1wslAFN6sw6Aqdvg3GDlbrvlpcG2YNbQNdaK1t5qGzPXSNbnEANaOJVXLXnFZGaa10a2sL0QdorB2i6mPbC6swJN5LzQsyvoFi_tlfWGq_r1V2C_NBovkQZhRmPM-z9jNdHFcvzHhFYUbM-ybXJ31LOsDjW9ICBUk-Sfol5VBwE2asigvHmXJO1N2EVY8VUv474v8KejnzGwAA__8TfnzV) to a new public benefit fund. Musk answered that post on X: "_I recommend giving the shares directly to the public_." Investor Brad Gerstner, who helped create Trump Accounts, called it the "largest philanthropic gift in history." Musk has [fallen short on past pledges](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0L_OozAQBPCnMR3IXpxgChfX0OXaK9Fi1sGK-SN7g5O3P_G9wtdMM9JvpPn3GB8YYtief3Elyx-_jxuVHImZ0pgZmTyGVBIe7wOTWzKHGPMIEu61kjXIER2Hk0aN1WwnOfeqIqu6HnSvlTLVYlsNCMaozpM2E3X3tjUGVO9c29JkdBXsxSkJUimpbrrR6N2Mrda9l8bfjNCS5sB7anghpg9mH7_7Salx-1pFuzAfWbR_BAwChlJK47bJXaWA4bIFDEpe0QsYKO5bvb7zq84HOvrUecFEuX6Gk7Dgt36FOTcLr7FKdj5KiDHkeye0fK4Y4s8m__ar08L_AAAA__-mf34q), including a promise of up to $1 billion to OpenAI, which received about $38 million.
## Supreme Court Takes Up Distilling Ban
The U.S. Supreme Court [agreed Monday to decide](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGurCAQhp9GOwwgq1JQ3MZub3tLM8KwkotiYFx33_7EPecNTjWZzOTL__3_7tMdQgzb4y-saOjl07ThWSISYZ4KAaGHkM8M-7FDtkuhEGOZJJcdE5xJPoGl8MRJQe3MzJ0WNRrRa6m0EmKoF6P0ILW2t2GevXaz7zvloGtF7zS0XWfrYC6c4JILwcVNNQq8ddAqpT0f_G2oFEcXKOWGFiR8QfHxnZ6YG5vWOpqFaC9V-6eSYyXH8zyb_y_YrmMlx8vnGkAhbRDZz16OPeOKzKYjE6PEHNrgkAXPRMfZGyGzFB1b0orMhY932B5sho2FwmzaCgU6vqGVHOts3H5eT6XrK8UfK4T4yUe_7fVp5FcAAAD__xwMkNM) whether a federal law dating to the 1860s can stop Americans from distilling whiskey, vodka, and other spirits at home, in a case brought by Texas hobbyists. Violators face up to five years in prison and a $10,000 fine. In April, the 5th U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals sided with the Texas-based [Hobby Distillers Association](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDGOgzAQRU9jOiN7YsAULrahy7ZbosEMwZIByx5C9var5ApbP-np__dzH-8YYtgf37iR49dyjDtdJRIz5bEwMi0Y8pUxnQmzXwuHGMsIClqplQQ1oufwpNFgNbtJzb2uyOmuB9MbrW21OtsuaBrVQuOVbTRAZyx0vZqtmaDxTRXcW6cVKK2VbkxtcPEz3ozpF2WXxgqjaA585JpXYnphWeLv8aRc-2OroluZUxG3LwGDgOG6rtqv-djfVMAwnSXsVIqAATMHH0nAUM6UaSPpjzOz_Djlemwk5_C5GPaHnHCXAMbe2s7UaU1VdnO63rC0nTDqsWGInwn833RPB38BAAD__9Q4hHY) against the ban, while the 6th Circuit upheld it in an Ohio case. Challengers call the 1868 law a relic of Reconstruction-era politics, arguing Congress [overstepped its taxing power](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOpDAMhp8mdB4lIcsOBcU1dHvtlcgEM1iCBDkGdt_-xLzCNm5sff7_79_X8IW8cnr9xY06_Z7zkOgqK6mSDEVRaUaWS3A_dpS4FOV1LYO3vgFnwdsBo_JJQ8Bq6kY7ta6izn22PrTBuWe1dDTOTXCIdT1OSG1TT-3YxLGuCe3ofKy4u3HOeuucdR_hEXCOE9YhtLN9zh9PEyxNrFkeupDSN5Z5_cknySPmrVq7RXUvpv5jfG98n372XPReGd_fZON7Z-_RGt8fBe6Gxvfl2IU2gpgPUcCXEBXQDEIn0wUIQjGnonJE5ZyABGHEBDnBxG8PnF5QdhbWApxgFz5RCZa80f2gkm7ar_uuNJ8m2NeGvL4j629Vn53_HwAA___M-pc6). Government lawyers counter that the ban keeps producers from dodging federal liquor taxes and warn that striking it would erode Congress' authority. Rick Morris, who started the Texas group in 2013, says distilling is the [natural next step](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkD2O4zAMhU8jdw5EWrGtQsU27mbbLQ2OfmIBcmRIdDy5_UK5wjQEiw-P_N6_r_WLYorPx1_aveGfkNenv2ryzL6slYl9oFiuQsd5ULFb5ZhSXVHi2IPsUa5kOb78qqhz5ls6DZ03MGlUWgHM3WbAD2TH2U7uewoWNN1HB1Y7nOUwBYtdNC0OJEoACXd1UxSso0EpHeQc7rNQ0rvIudx48-x_qIb0zi9fbjbvXTIb81HF8EfgInC5rut2VuLs6N0AgUvlXN4Cl-YmcDlyihxtW9tlgQvINnRDz6P43fc2n4X7Le--d_FjHZ-PnpLNW059PWKJ3AI0AgIoLeUkcOmKccfV4DpOQsnHTjF9vuTftvsy-D8AAP__yXCPJA) for hobbyists who already make beer and wine. The justices are expected to hear arguments next year and rule by the end of June.

name: Ken Burns
subject: A heartfelt request:
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Alex Vindman for Florida
body:
Eugene Vindman deserves your support.

[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/evfc-em-oct26?refcode=em261020-av-ken-burns&refcode2=1165_3892029_qaZYkq&akid=1165%2E3892029%2EqaZYkq)
---
Hi, it’s Ken Burns. I am coming to you with a heartfelt request:
[**If you, like me, are deeply concerned about the future of our democracy and the rising tide of extremism, I urge you to join me in supporting Eugene Vindman’s reelection campaign for Congress today.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/evfc-em-oct26?refcode=em261020-av-ken-burns&refcode2=1165_3892029_qaZYkq&akid=1165%2E3892029%2EqaZYkq)
As a filmmaker, my life’s work has been dedicated to capturing pivotal moments in American history — moments that have shaped our nation’s identity and spirit. I’ve documented our country navigating through its darkest hours and emerging stronger and understanding the profound consequences of these moments.
Throughout my career, I’ve seen our nation evolve in countless ways, but one constant remains: our democracy, the cornerstone of our republic, and the essence of what it means to be American.
Yet, at this very moment, our democracy faces an unprecedented challenge — a critical inflection point. We are at a juncture where our very rights and freedoms are threatened.
The stakes have never been higher. Our democracy stands at a crossroads — and this moment requires leaders who will unify our country in defense of the very fabric of our nation — no matter political party or affiliation. Eugene Vindman is one of those leaders.
I first met Eugene and Alex nearly 40 years ago, when I interviewed the Vindman twins and their grandmother for a documentary about the meaning of the Statue of Liberty. It was shortly after they fled Soviet Ukraine and sought refuge in the United States as children.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/evfc-em-oct26?refcode=em261020-av-ken-burns&refcode2=1165_3892029_qaZYkq&akid=1165%2E3892029%2EqaZYkq)
Their father came to the U.S. with $759 in his pocket, three children, and a dream of giving them a better life. And through hard work and perseverance, they achieved just that.
Eugene’s story is the embodiment of the American dream. He is a Ukrainian immigrant, an Army Veteran, and a lifelong defender of our democracy. He’s a good man — one who has devoted himself to defending our country with courage, selflessness, and resilience, even at his own expense.
Eugene has never failed to hold our leaders accountable — no matter their party. But right now, not only is our government baselessly retaliating against him through an investigation aimed at removing him from Congress, but he is being attacked relentlessly by the far right, all because he has never failed to hold our leaders accountable.
We need to keep people like Eugene in Congress — leaders who continue to stand up for our democracy and represent the true spirit of America.
So it would mean a lot to me if you could support his reelection campaign today to help keep him fighting for us in the People’s House.
[**Can you please contribute $25 or whatever you can afford to Eugene Vindman’s campaign for Congress today? I am asking because it is critical.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/evfc-em-oct26?refcode=em261020-av-ken-burns&refcode2=1165_3892029_qaZYkq&akid=1165%2E3892029%2EqaZYkq)

Hillsdale College's popular online course, **" The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives,"** is now FREE on DVD.

In this six-lecture course, you'll explore some of the major themes of Genesis, including the complex relationship between God and man, and what it reveals about divine and human nature.

"The Genesis Story" is taught by Hillsdale College professor of English Justin Jackson, who has taught the subject to undergraduate students here at the College for 15 years. This course aims to deepen a student's theological understanding of the Old Testament by revealing the literary beauty and complexity of the text.

The course begins with a lecture and introduction by the president of Hillsdale College, Larry P. Arnn, in which he explains why we teach the Book of Genesis at Hillsdale College and why it's important to both faith and higher education.

Then, Dr. Jackson explains the four relationships that dominate the Book of Genesis: God and creation, God and man, man and man, and man and creation.

You'll explore these relationships in the narratives of Adam and Eve, Abraham and Sarah, Abraham and Isaac, Jacob and Esau, and finally, Joseph.

This course on DVD is perfect for viewing in your home with your family or for use in small groups such as Bible studies and book clubs.

**To receive your FREE Genesis DVD box set, please use the secure link here:**[https://info.hillsdale.edu/-genesis-free-dvd-offer](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckc2OnDoQhZ_G7ECmTPOzYHGvgGiiTEcJiyyR21VASca2sOl5_WiknhfI9nzSd6Rz_rwv75otu-2uD-o5xgU9Lmmnk6xO7F3cOTwofRC5zeMCEuq8lDnIRZvET1oqnWF_g7Jd24z6sumg6ppW3bK9VxKpaUsplYLH46ErXcuuXju4NQZBrRn3n75SgixBKmgLAsLGrFgqraG-gajkFVAnKthFRorG-xC85cQmFv7cMtvvKYUo1H8CJgETu9UXO1sbUVsqCC8BU76Ro8gxX0-iHJ-Y-3WlU6gpGqEGKbuqvkuo4Mf3_4efwzjOAuorHUv012lIqCGcPgYyid32QgchX4dQAx2a7Ss0-giaNyfU8Kpc8Ilf0LtELgk1fBvv4_w2T7_HcfnV5G_znH8NkZ09hg-2lmPdiEpun_bC-CNL_3rPs4e_AQAA__-SjJ_f)

Charlie said it best in the days leading up to President Trump's victory in 2024: _" I don't care about polls. __ __I don 't care about betting markets. __ __I don 't care about vibes. __ _ **_I care about how many ballots are in the box. _**_ __If we turnout, we win. __ _**_Do the work. " _** Do the work... Charlie knew there was no easy route to saving our country. He knew there were no shortcuts to victory. He wore a red band on his wrist every day -- a reminder of what it would take -- that read, _**" Be Better. Work Harder." **_ It wasn't just for motivation. Charlie lived by those four words, and he expected every one of us at Turning Point to live by them too. Peter, We’re two weeks out, and your inbox is probably full of asks from the biggest congressional races in the country. Those campaigns have more money than they can spend at this point. Another $25 really won't do much. **[Here it can.](https://wileyforwake.com/l/F2mEEf6JIAEA)** I’m asking you to split a contribution with Winn Decker, who’s running to flip state House District 37 in southern Wake County. Republican Erin Paré won this seat by about 3,600 votes in 2024. Even the conservative John Locke Foundation now rates it a pure toss-up. A race like this could come very well down to just a few hundred votes.
---
|
---
And Winn is being outspent. As of the June 30 reports, Paré had raised about $363,000 to Winn’s $173,000. In a state House race, $50 isn’t a drop in the bucket. It’s mail, digital ads, and support for volunteers knocking doors in Holly Springs and Fuquay-Varina. This one’s personal for me. In January I’ll take over the most understaffed DA’s office in North Carolina. The state funds 45 prosecutors in Wake. Its own formula says we need 70. This year’s budget added prosecutors all over the state, and Wake County got zero. Erin Paré is one of the House Appropriations Chairs. I know Winn Decker will fight for public safety funding for Wake County. [**Chip in $25 or $50, split between my campaign and Winn’s.**](https://wileyforwake.com/l/mBFfc95LHTfC) If you live in southern Wake, vote early and vote for Winn Decker. Let’s go win this one. — Wiley

Dear Donald,
You hand-picked Michael Whatley for the U.S. Senate and we all know he'll do anything you tell him if he's elected. He's about to get crushed, and you should see the loss for what it is: a direct repudiation of your failed leadership in the White House. When he loses on November 3rd, that loss is yours too, buddy.
I want to tell you why it's going to happen, because none of the sycophants around you will.
Here's the short version. You told North Carolinians you'd fight for working families. Then you governed for your billionaire donors, your family and yourself. North Carolinians have been totally screwed by high costs and they're pissed off. Now here's the long version.
#### **Reason one: You can 't gerrymander a Senate race.**
I used to serve in Congress. Your MAGA buddies in the NC General Assembly drew me out of my seat. Then they did it again for Don Davis' district last year, after you told them to. You can gerrymander a House district but you can't gerrymander the borders of our state. Every voter in North Carolina gets the same ballot and an equal say in this race.
#### **Reason two: Western North Carolina remembers Helene.**
You stood in Swannanoa and promised to help. Then you walked away. Your FEMA turned down Governor Stein's request to keep covering all of the debris removal and emergency costs, calling it "not warranted," and never explained why. This summer you sent Congress an $88 billion war funding request with zero dollars for Helene. Even Republican Sen. Ted Budd told Congress in July that too many projects in western North Carolina have stalled for lack of money. And last month in Gastonia, you told the crowd that if Whatley loses, you're not sending the money.
#### **Reason three: You slashed our health care to cut taxes for the rich.**
You can't claim to fight for working people when you cut their hospitals and health care. You can't claim to fight for working people when your bill puts health coverage at risk for 680,000 North Carolinians. And you definitely can't claim to fight for working people when you do it all to pay for tax breaks for the richest people in America. Your big ugly bill cut nearly $1 trillion from Medicaid. Our hospitals could lose $32 billion over the next decade, putting the rural hospitals that serve 80 of our 100 counties at risk. Even Thom Tillis warned you. You called him a "talker and complainer" and said he was "screwing the Republican party." He was telling you the truth.
#### **Reason four: You work for the billionaires. Period.**
During the last campaign you said, "when I win, I will immediately bring prices down, starting on day one." Here's what your big ugly bill actually does. The top 1% get an average tax cut of about $66,000 next year. Altogether, that's $117 billion for the richest 1% in a single year. The bottom 20% get a tax cut worth less than 1% of their income, and then lose more than that in health care and food assistance cuts. The nonpartisan Congressional Budget Office found that an earlier version of your bill would cost the poorest 10% of households about $1,600 a year. It's a big ugly bill written by and for the ultra-rich.
#### **Reason five: Our farmers are paying for your tariffs.**
Ask [Brandon Batten](https://substack.com/redirect/5d4956b0-900c-41df-a29a-dfae29ac2dc4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). His family farms soybeans at Triple B Farms in Four Oaks. Last fall, China stopped buying American soybeans because of your trade war, and he was left wondering who would take their place. "We need all the markets we can get," he said. A report from the conservative John Locke Foundation estimates your tariffs could [cost North Carolina farmers about $695 million](https://substack.com/redirect/2d33445d-c052-4cc6-a03a-406724820c79?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), roughly a third of average net farm income. That's not a liberal talking point. That's your own side's think tank. The head of the state's soybean growers [put it plainly](https://substack.com/redirect/0dbcbff1-77a1-4f9d-8f8c-c16e91d29d6e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg): "We're losing good farmers."
#### **Reason six: You made everything cost more.**
The day before you started your war with Iran, gas in North Carolina averaged about $2.75. Diesel shot up 71%, from $3.39 in January to a record $5.81 in April, and then broke that record again in September, topping $6. Just ask the Byrd family, who farm tobacco, corn, wheat and soybeans in Harnett County. In September, R.H. Byrd Jr. said diesel was running about $6.20 a gallon, roughly $2.75 more than a year earlier. "The cost of diesel is one of our biggest challenges," he said. Gas was still around $4 a gallon in Wendell earlier this month. Food prices are through the roof. Diesel moves our food, our lumber and just about everything on a store shelf. When it spikes, everything costs more. And your answer was that high energy costs are a "very small price to pay." Not for billionaires like you. For farmers in Harnett County, for the trucker in Kinston and for the mom in Garner filling up her minivan, it's a choice between gas and food.
#### **Reason seven: You took us into a war with Iran with no plan and no end in sight.**
You chose this war against Iran. You launched it on February 28th without coming to Congress. Nearly eight months later, the Pentagon counts 21 American service members dead and 865 wounded. A Fort Bragg soldier, 1st Lt. Tyler Feehan, was one of two killed in an Iranian attack on a base in Jordan. Our 82nd Airborne paratroopers are still over there, and their deployment has been extended into next year. There's still no plan to bring our people home. Every one of those costs is on you. Your own Pentagon says this war has already cost over $45 billion, and that doesn't count rebuilding all of the damaged bases. Moody's chief economist says it's [cost the average American household nearly $2,000](https://substack.com/redirect/46b7dd21-4bc9-4046-9b9b-b8b2afa48d11?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and counting. What happened to no more forever wars?
#### **Reason eight: DOGE gutted the Triangle.**
When DOGE started cutting grants, North Carolina's 4th District was the hardest hit in the country, losing 186 federal grants. RTI lost about $1 billion and laid off a third of its workforce. Our state health department lost more than $100 million in grants and cut more than 80 jobs, including work on immunizations and addiction treatment.
#### **Reason nine: You sent ICE raids into North Carolina.**
North Carolinians want a secure border. We also believe every person deserves to be treated with dignity. Last November, you sent the federal agents from your Charlotte operation into Raleigh and Cary.
You said you were going after the "worst of the worst." The numbers say otherwise. Of the more than 1,100 people arrested in North Carolina during and right after your Charlotte operation, just 30% had ever been convicted of a crime. Nationally, it's worse. Leaked federal data analyzed by the [libertarian Cato Institute](https://substack.com/redirect/6ff0c78c-386b-449a-925f-757800d78468?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) shows 73% of people booked into ICE detention had no criminal convictions at all. Only 5% had a violent conviction. That's not public safety. That's theater. And it's dangerous theater. In Minneapolis, an ICE officer shot and killed Renee Good, a 37-year-old mother. Weeks later, federal agents shot and killed Alex Pretti, an ICU nurse who cared for veterans. Deaths in ICE custody in 2025 were the highest in more than 20 years, and this year has already broken the all-time record.
I'm about to be Wake County's top prosecutor. I know what actually makes a community safer: going after violent criminals. That's not what you're doing.
#### **Reason ten: Your pardons are totally indefensible.**
I take the rule of law very seriously. You pardoned roughly 1,500 people charged in connection with the January 6th attack on the Capitol. Police officers were beaten that day. Their convicted attackers walked. Then you pardoned Changpeng Zhao, the Binance founder who pleaded guilty to money laundering, after Binance helped your family's crypto company land a $2 billion deal. When reporters asked, you said you didn't know who he was. In your America, if you're rich, connected or useful to the Trump family, the law just doesn't apply.
#### **Reason eleven: You 're cashing in while we pay more.**
While North Carolina families cut back, Forbes estimates your family nearly doubled its fortune to about $10 billion since the 2024 election. Your own financial disclosure reports at least [$1.4 billion in 2025 from your crypto](https://substack.com/redirect/3ad3c636-1c5c-4fdb-998d-a38e3f779c60?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and memecoin businesses. One of them, World Liberty Financial, you co-founded with your sons and Steven Witkoff, who's now one of your top diplomats. Then there's the plane. Qatar's royal family handed over a $400 million Boeing 747, and you promised it would go to your presidential library. North Carolinians can't accept a free car from a lobbyist. You accepted a jumbo jet from a foreign government. You're running the most corrupt White House ever, and it isn't even close.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6fb2c455-abd5-49db-ab7e-9926e1ca3c56?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
#### **And the last reason: Roy Cooper.**
You've thrown everything you've got at [Roy Cooper](https://substack.com/redirect/4fcf1312-7701-4a28-898c-996fe4fd279a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). You called him "radical left" and blamed him for the slow Helene recovery your own administration dragged out. You compared him to Michael Dukakis and Willie Horton and said he "DISGRACED North Carolina" and "disqualified himself from Public Office!" Now you're telling people our cities are "blood-soaked killing fields." North Carolinians know better. Roy Cooper has never lost an election. Voters have trusted him statewide again and again. They're about to do it one more time.
Here's the thing you'll never understand, Donald. The power of the presidency is real. But it's nothing compared to the power of North Carolinians standing in line at a polling place with a ballot in their hands. You can redraw maps. You can pardon your friends. You can take a jet from Qatar, but you can't stop what's coming on Tuesday, November 3rd.
So enjoy your breakfast on November 4th. Then start preparing to blame everyone but yourself for the upcoming blowout.
And if you're reading this and you're not Donald Trump: [NC early voting is open now](https://substack.com/redirect/17e24de5-ae0f-463f-941b-4974fd6e670e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) through October 31st. [Go vote for Roy Cooper](https://substack.com/redirect/4fcf1312-7701-4a28-898c-996fe4fd279a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Let's send a message so loud they hear it all the way in Mar-a-Lago.
Wiley

PS: Want to meet the guy leading the fight to flip the NC House? Robert Reives, the Democratic Leader in the House, is coming to my home in Cary on Thursday, October 22nd.
